# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [Unreleased]

## [1.1.0] - 2026-05-01

### Added

- Document the section-marker convention used in our deploy scripts:

  ```text
### --- hoge section start

### --- hoge section end
  ```

- Show a nested fence of a different length as literal content:

  ````text
  ```text
### inner fence marker
  ```
  ````

## [1.0.0] - 2026-04-01

### Added

- Initial public release.
